description:
Defines a SQL-backed store of versioned key-value entries.
Each entry is identified by a key and an effective time, and the full history of versions is kept for each key, so the value that was in effect at any point in time can be retrieved.
Unlike reference data, entries can be created, updated and deleted individually after they have been loaded.

Data is loaded into the store using the {{< pipe-elm "SqlStoreFilter" >}} pipeline element.
